Round 38 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

The playtest said the missile loop is finally satisfying — and named what still hurts. All four shipped: kills no longer bury your jet (they erupt at the victim and balloon past the camera, like the arcade), the shot that kills you strobes on every background, dying costs lives again (a held fire button was silently buying continues), and the empty-sky / parked-wingmen stretches are gone (crossings ran at half speed for 10 rounds).
“The missiles actually work now: I point roughly at a plane, a lock box snaps on, I press the button, and a second later that plane is a fireball — that loop is satisfying and I did it over and over on purpose.”
